package domain_test

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/courseplan"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/pedagogy"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func checkpointFixture(t *testing.T) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint) {
	t.Helper()
	ref := domain.TargetRef{Type: domain.TargetConcept, Key: "go.variables", Version: "v1"}
	graph := domain.GoalGraph{Goal: domain.LearningGoal{Code: "go.backend", Version: "v1", GraphVersion: "g-v1", Title: "Go"}, Targets: []domain.LearningTarget{{Ref: ref, Title: "Variables", ModuleCode: "m", ModuleTitle: "Module", SectionCode: "s", SectionTitle: "Section", LessonCode: "l", LessonTitle: "Lesson"}}}
	profile := domain.StudentPlanningProfile{DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "beginner", GoalCode: "go.backend", PreferredLanguage: "en", PreferredPace: "standard", ProfileVersion: domain.StudentPlanningProfileVersion, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, WeeklyMinutes: 60}
	policy := domain.PolicyBundle{PlannerVersion: domain.PlannerVersion, PedagogyProfile: domain.DefaultPedagogyProfile, PresentationStyle: domain.DefaultPresentationStyle, GenerationPolicy: domain.DefaultGenerationPolicy, MasterySkipConfidence: .8, PedagogyStrategies: []domain.PedagogyStrategyVersion{{Code: "explicit_instruction", Version: 1, Config: json.RawMessage(`{"z":1,"a":2}`)}}}
	mastery := []domain.TargetMastery{{Target: ref, State: domain.MasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: domain.StudentMasteryPolicyVersion}}
	r := domain.CoursePlanRequest{ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", RequestHash: strings.Repeat("a", 64), GoalCode: "go.backend", Intent: domain.PlanningIntent{Source: domain.PlanningSourceStudent, Reason: domain.PlanningReasonInitial, DesiredOutcome: "Learn"}}
	result, e := courseplan.BuildDeterministicCourseForIntent(graph, profile, mastery, policy, r.Intent, pedagogy.NewDefaultRegistry())
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	c, e := domain.NewPlanningInputCheckpoint(domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint{RequestID: r.ID, StudentID: r.StudentID, RequestHash: r.RequestHash, GoalCode: r.GoalCode, Intent: r.Intent, Graph: graph, Profile: profile, Mastery: mastery, Policy: policy, Draft: result.Course, Fingerprint: result.Fingerprint, NormalizedContext: result.NormalizedContext, GapTargets: result.GapTargets})
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create input: %v result=%+v", e, result)
	}
	return r, c
}
func TestPlanningInputImmutableBindingAndContext(t *testing.T) {
	r, c := checkpointFixture(t)
	if c.Validate(r) != nil {
		t.Fatal("valid input rejected")
	}
	r.LearningPathID = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	if c.Validate(r) != nil {
		t.Fatal("INITIAL resolution changed original binding")
	}
	r.RequestHash = strings.Repeat("b", 64)
	if c.Validate(r) == nil {
		t.Fatal("changed request hash accepted")
	}
}
func TestPlanningCheckpointChainRejectsTamper(t *testing.T) {
	r, c := checkpointFixture(t)
	g, e := domain.NewGeneratedCourseCheckpoint(c, c.Draft)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	receipt, e := domain.NewCourseEnsureCheckpoint(c, g, domain.EnsureCourseResult{CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", Lessons: []domain.CourseLessonBinding{{LessonID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Order: 0, Targets: c.GapTargets}}})
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	receipt.Result.Reused = true
	if receipt.Validate(c, g) == nil {
		t.Fatal("tampered receipt accepted")
	}
	g.Course.Fingerprint = strings.Repeat("0", 64)
	if g.Validate(c) == nil {
		t.Fatal("tampered artifact accepted")
	}
	c.Profile.WeeklyMinutes++
	if c.Validate(r) == nil {
		t.Fatal("tampered projection accepted")
	}
}
func TestPlanningCheckpointStrictDecode(t *testing.T) {
	var c domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint
	for _, raw := range []string{`{"unknown":true}`, `{} {}`, `null`, `{"schema":"x","schema":"y"}`} {
		e := domain.DecodePlanningCheckpoint([]byte(raw), 128, &c)
		if e == nil {
			t.Fatalf("accepted %s", raw)
		}
	}
}

func TestPrivateInputHashSeparatesStudentFromCourseIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	r, c := checkpointFixture(t)
	changed := c
	changed.StudentID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	other, e := domain.NewPlanningInputCheckpoint(changed)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if other.InputHash == c.InputHash || other.Fingerprint != c.Fingerprint {
		t.Fatal("private job identity contaminated shared Course identity")
	}
	if c.Validate(r) != nil {
		t.Fatal("constructor mutated original")
	}
}
func TestGeneratedPinCannotChangeDraftStructure(t *testing.T) {
	_, c := checkpointFixture(t)
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(c.Draft)
	var changed domain.GeneratedCourse
	_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &changed)
	changed.Modules[0].Code = "forged-module"
	if _, e := domain.NewGeneratedCourseCheckpoint(c, changed); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("artifact changed trusted structure")
	}
}
func TestInputPayloadAccommodatesExistingDraftBoundAndRejectsOversized(t *testing.T) {
	_, c := checkpointFixture(t)
	c.Draft.Description = strings.Repeat("x", 5<<20)
	c.Graph.Goal.Description = c.Draft.Description
	valid, e := domain.NewPlanningInputCheckpoint(c)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatalf("legitimate draft beyond old4MiB cap rejected: %v", e)
	}
	if len(valid.Draft.Description) != 5<<20 {
		t.Fatal("draft truncated")
	}
	c.Draft.Description = strings.Repeat("x", domain.MaximumGeneratedCoursePayloadBytes)
	if _, e = domain.NewPlanningInputCheckpoint(c); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("oversized existing course draft accepted")
	}
}

func TestInputPinPreservesExistingLargeGraphEnvelope(t *testing.T) {
	r, c := checkpointFixture(t)
	c.Graph.Targets = nil
	c.Graph.Transitions = nil
	c.Mastery = nil
	for i := 0; i < 500; i++ {
		ref := domain.TargetRef{Type: domain.TargetConcept, Key: fmt.Sprintf("go.target-%d", i), Version: "v1"}
		c.Graph.Targets = append(c.Graph.Targets, domain.LearningTarget{Ref: ref, Title: "Target", ModuleCode: "m", ModuleTitle: "Module", SectionCode: "s", SectionTitle: "Section", LessonCode: fmt.Sprintf("l-%d", i), LessonTitle: "Lesson", LessonOrder: i})
		c.Mastery = append(c.Mastery, domain.TargetMastery{Target: ref, State: domain.MasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: domain.StudentMasteryPolicyVersion})
		for _, stack := range []string{"go", "php", "sql"} {
			c.Graph.Transitions = append(c.Graph.Transitions, domain.TransitionKnowledge{SourceStack: stack, Target: ref, Similarity: "Similarity", Difference: "Difference", AnalogyBoundary: "Boundary"})
		}
	}
	for i := 0; i < 80; i++ {
		c.Profile.KnownStacks = append(c.Profile.KnownStacks, fmt.Sprintf("unused-%d", i))
		c.Policy.PedagogyStrategies = append(c.Policy.PedagogyStrategies, domain.PedagogyStrategyVersion{Code: "explicit_instruction", Version: i + 2, Config: json.RawMessage(`{}`)})
	}
	result, e := courseplan.BuildDeterministicCourseForIntent(c.Graph, c.Profile, c.Mastery, c.Policy, r.Intent, pedagogy.NewDefaultRegistry())
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatalf("existing deterministic envelope rejects fixture: %v", e)
	}
	c.Draft = result.Course
	c.Fingerprint = result.Fingerprint
	c.NormalizedContext = result.NormalizedContext
	c.GapTargets = result.GapTargets
	pinned, e := domain.NewPlanningInputCheckpoint(c)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatalf("valid existing500target/1500transition/80stack/81strategy projection was rejected: %v", e)
	}
	if len(pinned.Graph.Transitions) != 1500 || len(pinned.Profile.KnownStacks) != 80 || len(pinned.Policy.PedagogyStrategies) != 81 {
		t.Fatal("existing projection envelope truncated")
	}
}

func TestPinnedFingerprintContextRejectsStudentIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	_, c := checkpointFixture(t)
	var projection map[string]any
	if json.Unmarshal(c.NormalizedContext, &projection) != nil {
		t.Fatal("fixture context")
	}
	projection["student_id"] = c.StudentID
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(projection)
	c.NormalizedContext = raw
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	c.Fingerprint = hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	c.Draft.Fingerprint = c.Fingerprint
	if _, e := domain.NewPlanningInputCheckpoint(c); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("student identity entered shared Course fingerprint context")
	}
}
